description: The official Wappie plugin: connects your assistant to your WhatsApp archive in Wappie through its attested reader.

plugins.name: wappie
plugins.description: Access to your WhatsApp archive in Wappie through its attested reader: metadata by default, and message text and attachments only with your consent. Wappie tested Claude Code, an app on your computer; Codex connects as an assistant Wappie has not tested, within its limits. Neither drafts messages nor writes notes to your own chat.
